caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture with a rectangular table structure and a two-door cabinet on top. The entire object is rendered in shades of reddish-brown, indicating a polished wood surface, with areas highlighted in golden or yellowish tones along the edges and decorative inlays. The upper cabinet section consists of two doors, each featuring a central oval shape and linear geometric patterns, and each door has a small round metal keyhole. Below the cabinet is a flat tabletop surface. The lower section is a table supported by four straight, narrow legs. The front side beneath the tabletop displays a single rectangular drawer, which is outlined in gold and has a small central knob, and is adorned with two circular medallion-like designs, one on each side. The upper parts of the legs feature oval green accents, and the front-facing legs have additional vertical floral motifs in yellow and green hues running partway down the length. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Lady's Writing Cabinet
